## Workload

During the review period, grader Elif Sahin completed 501 reads over 410 hours. This represents a rate of 1.2 reads per hour. The workload was recorded against the review period and provides the basis for assessing both activity and performance. The figures indicate the volume of work completed and the time spent undertaking it.

## Quality

Reviewer Priya Anand checked 43 reads from the completed workload. Agreement across the checked reads was 81.4 per cent. This result is recorded as part of the quality review and should be considered alongside the workload information. The review provides a clear record of the reads assessed, the level of agreement reached, and the reviewer responsible for the assessment.
